title: Life, Science and Art by Ernest Hello
text:
Life, Science and Art by Ernest Hello
Wise and Suffering Soul
Life, Science and Art: Leaves from the Pages of Ernest Hello
Translated from the French by E.M. Walker
Introduced and edited by Gary Furnell
The Philosophical Notes series No. 4
Connor Court, 2025, 112 pages, $24.95
This little book is the fourth in a series titled Philosophical Notes, all from the hand of the same editor, Gary Furnell, who also provides it with a short introduction and some footnotes. The core of the book is a collection of thirty-one short essays (perhaps meditations would be a better word) on various aspects of the human condition, by French journalist Ernest Hello (1828–1885). There is also a brief note from the translator, E.M. Walker. It is difficult to review a book as diverse in content as this one: an abbreviated list of topics makes that plain. “Art”, “Hope”, “The Friends of Job”, “History”, “Science”, “Indifference” are just a few titles.
We shall come to a greater appreciation of the book…
